patches.summary: Register the eight hand-coded transcendence commands (fanout group + soul-ids search/usage + account spend) into the generator-emitted Cobra tree.
patches.reason: Phase 1.5 brainstorm approved eight novel commands the generator does not emit. Registering them required adding AddCommand calls to root.go (fanout top-level), soul_ids.go (search + usage subcommands), and account.go (spend subcommand). These three files are otherwise templated; the additions are bracketed by PATCH comments so regen reviewers can preserve the wiring.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./... && printing-press shipcheck (6/6 legs PASS, scorecard 87/100 Grade A)
